question: AB is the diameter of a circle with centre O. If P be point on the circle such that ∠AOP = 110°, then the measure of ∠OBP is:
solution:
**Given:**

AB is the diameter of a circle with centre O. If P be point on the circle such that ∠AOP = 110°

**Formula used:**

Sum of the angles of triangle = 180°

**Calculations:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc72c6d814d8f1e5c755e106a25ea19f8832a9ca4daa1e8a1f3c6d82282dd0be.png] 

As from figure,

⇒ OA = OP = OB = radius

In ΔOPB

⇒ OP = OB

so, ΔOPB is an isosceles triangle

⇒ ∠OPB = ∠OBP = x

As, AB is an striaght line

⇒ ∠AOP + ∠POB = 180°

⇒ ∠POB = 180° - 110° = 70°

In ΔOPB,

⇒ ∠O + ∠P + ∠B = 180°

⇒ 70° + x + x = 180°

⇒ 2x = 180° - 70° = 110°

⇒ x = 55°

⇒ **Hence, The measure of the ∠OBP is 55º**
